title: IBM watsonx.data 2.4.0 through 2.4.0 patch 8 could allow a remote authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service…
description: IBM watsonx.data versions 2.4.0 through 2.4.0 patch 8 contain a vulnerability that allows a remote authenticated attacker to cause a denial of service. This issue arises from client-side enforcement of business rules, which can be bypassed or exploited to disrupt service availability.
